caption: The drawing features a detailed pencil sketch of a tankard or mug positioned in the center of a lightly outlined square. The tankard is cylindrical with a slightly wider base, a defined rim at the top, and a pronounced, curved handle connecting the side to the upper part of the body. The main body and base display subtle shading to suggest a metallic or reflective surface. The composition is monochromatic, rendered in shades of grey on a light beige background. In the lower left and right corners of the square, there are two smaller diagrams: the left diagram shows the side profile of the handle with labeled dimensions, while the right diagram depicts the front view of the tankard with measured proportions indicated. Both diagrams include measurement lines and numeric labels. The word "MEYERS" and "SCALE 1 IN." are inscribed below the tankard drawing towards the left. The overall layout is clean, with ample blank space surrounding the central and corner sketches.
title: Pewter Mug
